text: In which year did Kyiv celebrate its 1,500th anniversary?

meta.exposure_note: exposed in git history through f819d9b; reclassified shadow-dev per Issue 1; never sealed

sufficient_sets.text: Scholars continue to debate when the city was founded. The traditional founding date is 482 CE, so the city celebrated its 1,500th anniversary in 1982. Archaeological data indicates a founding in the sixth or seventh centuries, with some researchers dating the founding as late as the late 9th century.
